<a name="OpenRepairMsg"></a>
## type OpenRepairMsg

OpenRepairMsg asks the controller to open the configure flow, whose sync re\-applies Takt's configuration, after a capability failed its check.

```go
type OpenRepairMsg struct{}
```

<a name="State"></a>
## type State

State identifies the visible diagnostics step, mirroring the drift and uninstall screens' state shape.

```go
type State int
```

<a name="StateCollecting"></a>

```go
const (
    // StateCollecting is the async verify.Collect run.
    StateCollecting State = iota
    // StateNotInstalled short-circuits collection: there is nothing to check.
    StateNotInstalled
    // StateReport is the collected report.
    StateReport
)
```
